text:
Maya: Pushed a new compact starter-flow Figma frame for the onboarding ribbon. Main change is stacked sample project cards with an inline CTA right-aligned instead of the persistent bottom banner. Fig link: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz (see frame 'Starter > Cards'). Thoughts?

Dan: I like the reduced vertical real estate. Do we risk lower discoverability with the CTA tucked to the right on narrow viewports?

Jess: Conversion sanity check — can we run a small A/B: inline CTA vs persistent bottom bar CTA for the first 10k new users? Quick metric: click-to-setup.

Sam: Frontend note: inline CTA is simpler visually, but current DOM order places the CTA after the card body so keyboard tabbing jumps from heading -> details -> CTA. We should move the CTA earlier in the DOM or set proper tabindex. Example: <button class="sample-cta" aria-label="Start with sample">Start</button>.

Priya: Accessibility: the CTA color in the frame drops to ~3.6:1 on the dark overlay — fails WCAG AA for normal text. Also the focus ring is subtle on compact cards. Recommend >=4.5:1 and clearer focus outline (3px or accessible shadow). Also ensure touch target >=44px.

Maya: Good catches. Microcopy question: prefer "Create sample project" or "Start with sample" for the button copy? Trying to keep it tight on mobile.

Jess: Leaning "Start with sample" — shorter and action-y on small buttons.

Dan: Mobile concern again: touch target needs 44px; current collapsed CTA is ~36px. We'll need to increase padding which will affect stacking.

Sam: CSS suggestion (rough):
```
.sample-cta { min-height: 44px; padding: 12px 16px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; }
.card-meta { display: none; } /* collapse nonessential meta on <420px */
```
This keeps layout stable but we should test wrapping.

a11y-bot: Automated scan: missing aria-label on sample card close button on frame 'Starter > Cards'. Recommendation: add aria-label="Remove sample project".

Priya: Also add aria-live="polite" on the onboarding step region so SR users hear the step change when a sample is selected. And verify the expanded/collapsed state uses aria-expanded on the toggle.

Maya: I'll update Figma (change CTA color to #0055CC, microcopy to "Start with sample", increase touch target, add aria labels + notes for focus styles). Will drop new frames by EOD.

Jess: Can we keep sample projects optional in the checklist? For enterprise flows it might be noise. Suggest a "Show samples" toggle in the checklist — default ON for PLG orgs, OFF for enterprise (config flag).

Maya: Agree. UX: collapsed pill with chevron to expand. Toggle state persists per-account.

Sam: Implementation: add data-qa attribute for e2e: data-qa="onboard-samples-toggle". Also wire keyboard activation for Enter/Space and maintain focus.

Priya: Microcopy tweak: label the toggle "Show sample projects (recommended)" — the word "recommended" helps surfacing but if we visually hide it with sr-only, ensure sighted users still see recommendation. I'd keep it visible.

Maya: Plan: update frames, annotate a11y callouts, and prepare a short 5-person usability script focusing on discoverability and keyboard nav. Will post updated files in #design-review and ping folks.

Jess: Also add a GA checklist item to capture click-through and conversion delta for the two CTA variants.

Dan: :thumbsup: 

Maya: Thanks all — will follow up with new Figma export + a tiny PR for DOM order suggestion.
